brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.

requirements.evidence: One Hex base · Full (piece:0,0,0;full) with top and bottom Cover · Full (cover top/bottom) and five solid edge caps on the side faces (cap at 30, 90, 150, 210, 270, 330 degrees, six caps in total). Check_build reports no issues and meshClash clear.

requirements.requirement: Louvred vent so the board inside can breathe
requirements.evidence: One Port louvre (port:0#0,0#0, hex-port-louvre) on side slot 0 of the base. It is the only opening in the otherwise closed shell. The louvre port is a configurator part; its airflow performance is not verified.

No circuit board or electronics part exists in the catalog, and I did not add a board prop. The build is an empty enclosure shell with the vent; the interior is the base cell, which is solid-block geometry, not a board tray.
The configurator checks fit and collisions only; it does not verify material, airflow, waterproofing or heat behaviour of the printed parts.

finish.summary: Built a closed single-cell enclosure: a full hex base with top and bottom covers, six side caps closing every face except one, and a louvre port on side slot 0 as the vent. check_build is clean (meshClash clear, no issues). The enclosure and vent are in place; no board was modelled because the catalog has no electronics part, and airflow and material properties are not verified by the configurator.
